void.body: Contact {business} if you were expecting to accept it.

accept.descriptionWithDeposit: You're accepting quote {number} from {business} for {total}, with {deposit} payable to commence. {business} will be notified right away.

decline.description: Lets {business} know you won't be going ahead with quote {number}.

deadLink.title: This quote link isn't valid
deadLink.body: The link may have been mistyped, or the quote is no longer available. Check the link in your email, or contact the business that sent it.
